messages:
incident-bot: PAGE — P1 latency spike detected for router tier: p95=210ms, p99=1.8s, streaming stalls increasing; affected regions: eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Paging sam_oncall and eng-sre.
sam_oncall: on it, joining bridge. Confirming scope — is this router-only or upstream model backlog too?
meena_sre: telemetry — looks like a sudden spike in tail latency on router policy evaluation path. Heatmap: https://monitoring.redwood/heatmaps/router/policy/1764447 — hot shard concentration around shard-27/zone-b.
carlos_runtime: seeing elevated connection queue / backpressure on balancer->router handoff, KV cache misses up 3x; logs show repeated 503s from shard-27 under heavy fanout.
jen_product: any customer-facing errors reported yet? nora_support?
nora_support: support queue has 7 threads citing streaming stalls and timeouts for long-chat sessions; a couple enterprise customers reported partial transcripts missing. Marking potential customer-impact: streaming degrade, not complete failure.
sam_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause recent routing policy rollout; 2) shift traffic off shard-27 to other shards; 3) enable eager fallback for streaming requests. Who can pause the rollout?
deploy-bot: rollback trigger available: /deploy rollback routing-policy/2026-03-14-rollout --to=stable
carlos_runtime: I can trigger pause/rollback. Recommending pause first, then selective redistribution. Executing: /deploy pause routing-policy/2026-03-14-rollout now.
meena_sre: telemetry shows policy version bump at 1764446800 correlated with spike. If pause doesn't cut it, we should rollback to v1.12 which had lower tail.
sam_oncall: carlos — after pause, can you run a quick redistribute to move ~30% of shard-27 traffic to shard-31 and shard-10? Use graceful drain to avoid connection churn.
carlos_runtime: running redistribute: ```infractl redistribute --from shard-27 --to shard-31,shard-10 --pct 30 --grace-period 45s``` will post progress.
ops-bot: redistribution started; progress: 12% -> 45% -> 100% (updates coming as reactions)
meena_sre: after redistribution p95 dropped to 120ms, p99 down to 680ms in eu-west-1. us-west-2 still high ~900ms p99. Looks promising in eu-west.
sam_oncall: good. For us-west-2, can we temporarily increase local affinity to prefer local nodes? That should cut cross-zone penalties.
carlos_runtime: applying local affinity tweak: ```routerctl set-affinity --region us-west-2 --preference local --duration 20m``` applying now.
jen_product: notifying customers: Nora, please post an advisory to affected customers mentioning degraded streaming and that we're doing traffic redistribution and rollback as a fallback. Use neutral language and ETA ~30m.
nora_support: drafting now — will include root cause hypothesis (routing policy rollout) and mitigation steps. Sending copy to Jen for approval.
meena_sre: side note: KV cache pressure increased because some hot keys got routed to nodes without warmed caches — that amplified tail. Need a postmortem item: pre-warm or sticky routing for hot keys.
sam_oncall: agree. Also schedule an immediate runbook update: add step to detect heat concentration by shard and auto-evacuate hot shard when p99 > 1s for 5m.
ops-bot: redistribution completed for eu-west-1. us-west-2 redistribution in progress (45%).
carlos_runtime: us-west-2 redistribution hit a stuck connection pattern on one host, manually draining that host fixed it. p99 now 420ms across us-west-2. We're seeing streaming success rate up to 98% from 84%.
meena_sre: adding quick checks: run `curl` waveform to streaming endpoints and capture tail; also check batching queue lengths. ```for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -H "Prefer: stream" https://api.redwood/stream | grep -m1 token; done``` — samples show token delays resolved.
sam_oncall: marking incident as mitigated for customer-impact (severity degraded -> partial) but keep P1 until we confirm stable for 60m. Next steps: 1) full rollback to stable if we see any regression; 2) postmortem with timeline and actionable prevention (sticky hotkey handling, rollout canary smaller, pre-warm caches); 3) update runbooks.
jen_product: agree on follow-ups. Also recommend we create a customer-facing postmortem template for those enterprise accounts that were impacted.
nora_support: sent advisory to affected customers. Copy: "We observed increased streaming latency in eu-west-1/us-west-2 due to a routing policy rollout that concentrated traffic on a subset of routers. We have redistributed traffic and applied mitigations; service performance is returning to normal. We'll follow up with a detailed update." Jen approved.
carlos_runtime: committing a defensive change: add safeguard to routing-policy controller to limit shard-pct increases to 10% per 5m during rollouts. Filing PR now.
meena_sre: creating incident ticket INC-1764447009 and will attach dashboards, traces, and logs. Assigning to eng-runtime for PM/owner and to SRE for follow-up.
sam_oncall: final note: thanks everyone for quick action. I'll hand this to oncall-turnover tomorrow and schedule a 1h scrub to validate the redistributions didn't create downstream pressure. Leaving thread open until postmortem draft.
